name: Infoblox — DNS Resolution of Unsanctioned Cloud Storage
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = infoblox_infoblox_raw
| filter xdm.event.type = "DNS Query"
| filter xdm.event.description contains "mega.nz" or xdm.event.description contains "anonfiles" or xdm.event.description contains "pcloud" or xdm.event.description contains "tresorit" or xdm.event.description contains "wetransfer" or xdm.event.description contains "filebin" or xdm.event.description contains "transfer.sh" or xdm.event.description contains "send.now" or xdm.event.description contains "dropbox" or xdm.event.description contains "drive.google" or xdm.event.description contains "box.com" or xdm.event.description contains "pastebin"
| filter xdm.source.ipv4 != null
| alter domain = arrayindex(regextract(xdm.event.description, "query: (\S+) IN"), 0)
| bin _time span = 1h
| comp count_distinct(domain) as lookups,
       values(domain) as bad_domains,
       values(xdm.event.type) as operations,
       values(xdm.event.description) as events_seen
       by xdm.source.ipv4, _time
| fields xdm.source.ipv4, events_seen, bad_domains
description: Infoblox DNS query for mega.nz, anonfiles, pcloud, tresorit, wetransfer, filebin, transfer.sh, send.now, dropbox, drive.google, box.com, or pastebin — potential cloud-storage exfiltration target.
alert_name: Infoblox — DNS Resolution of Unsanctioned Cloud Storage

TA0010 - Exfiltration: T1567.002 - Exfiltration Over Web Service: Cloud Storage
